features.name: The Changes panel
features.what: Changes lists the project's uncommitted files with their added and removed line counts; a file opens to its diff. The list refreshes after the agent's edits, after a save in the editor and each time the panel is shown.
features.reach: Click Changes on the right rail of a session.
features.proof: The changed file is listed with its counts, its diff shows the added and removed lines, a clean project says so, a save or an outside change shows up at the moments above.

scenarios.title: The file the agent edited is listed with +12 −2 and opens to its diff
A project without changes says the working tree is clean
Files changed and added outside the app show once the panel is opened again
A save in the file editor shows up in Changes
An open diff reads its file again when an agent's command finishes, even with the same +1 −1

features.name: Diff layout
features.what: A file's diff shows as one column or side by side.
features.reach: Open a file in Changes, click the side-by-side button on its header.
features.proof: The diff switches to two columns and back.

scenarios.title: The side-by-side toggle splits the diff and joins it back

features.name: View options
features.what: More actions on the Changes toolbar switches the list to a file tree, wraps long lines, hides whitespace-only changes and puts every diff side by side.
features.reach: Open Changes with changed files, click More actions (the dots) on its toolbar, pick an option.
features.proof: Tree view shows folders and one file's diff at a time, Wrap lines wraps the diff, Hide whitespace changes drops whitespace-only lines from the diff, Side-by-side view splits every diff.

scenarios.title: Tree view shows the first file, a click on another file shows that one, a folder collapses
Wrap lines wraps the open diff and turns off again
Hide whitespace changes drops a re-indented line from the diff and keeps the real change

features.name: Change scopes
features.what: The Changed: N switch picks what Changes lists: uncommitted changes, staged ones, the last turn's edits, or one commit.
features.reach: Open Changes, click Changed: N on its toolbar, pick Last turn or Commit.
features.proof: Last turn lists only the files the agent's last turn edited, Commit lists the picked commit's files and opens their diffs.

scenarios.title: Last turn lists the file the agent edited and leaves out a file changed outside
Commit lists the project's first commit and opens a file it added

features.name: Review and walkthrough from Changes
features.what: AI Review on the Changes toolbar asks how to start a review session; Walkthrough opens a guided walkthrough of the changes.
features.reach: Open Changes with changed files, click AI Review or Walkthrough on its toolbar.
features.proof: AI Review opens the Review changes dialog, which Cancel closes; Walkthrough opens the Walkthrough surface.

scenarios.title: AI Review opens the Review changes dialog and Cancel closes it

steps.text: Start a separate review session for the current changes.

scenarios.title: Walkthrough opens the Walkthrough surface

features.name: Find in changes
features.what: Cmd/Ctrl+F over Changes searches the diffs; every match is painted in its row, the active one stronger, and the arrows walk through them.
features.reach: Open a file in Changes, press Cmd/Ctrl+F, type a word.
features.proof: The matches are marked in the rows, the count reads N/M, Next moves the active mark to the next row, closing the bar removes every mark.

scenarios.title: A search marks its 3 matches, Next moves to the second, closing clears the marks
Cmd/Ctrl+click on a word in a diff opens find on that word
A match inside a diff held behind Render anyway shows that diff

features.name: Comments on diff lines
features.what: The + in the gutter opens a comment on that row; a drag over the code selects several rows and opens one comment on all of them. A saved comment stays under its rows; an empty one cannot be saved.
features.reach: Open a file in Changes, point at a row and click the + next to its number, or drag across rows of code.
features.proof: The field opens under the right rows, the saved card names its range and sits under the last row, Attach stays disabled and Enter saves nothing while the field is blank.

scenarios.title: The gutter + opens a comment on its row, and the saved comment stays under that row

steps.text: Check the name, not the class
Check the name, not the class

scenarios.title: A blank comment cannot be saved: Attach stays disabled and Enter adds nothing
A drag across five rows of code opens one comment that is saved on lines 10-14

features.name: Hidden context
features.what: Unchanged lines between hunks are folded into a separator; a click on it shows them.
features.reach: Open a file with two hunks in Changes, click the separator between them.
features.proof: The folded lines are not in the diff before the click and are after it.

scenarios.title: A click on the separator between the two hunks shows the 7 lines it folds

features.name: Hunk actions
features.what: Pointing at a hunk of an unstaged diff shows Discard and Stage for that hunk alone.
features.reach: Open a changed file in Changes, point at a hunk, click Stage or Discard over its last line.
features.proof: Stage moves only that hunk to Staged; Discard, after its confirm, puts only that hunk back to the committed text on disk.

scenarios.title: Stage on the first hunk leaves the second in Changed and moves the first to Staged
Discard on the second hunk, confirmed, restores only that hunk's lines on disk
Unstage on a staged hunk takes it out of Staged

features.name: Opening a file in Changes from the chat
features.what: A file named in the chat (an edit tool's Open file diff, a changed file under the answer) opens Changes at that file with its diff open.
features.reach: In a session where the agent edited a file, click Open file diff on the edit row, or the changed file under the answer.
features.proof: Changes opens with that file's diff expanded, without a click in the panel.

scenarios.title: Open file diff on an Edit File row opens Changes with retry.ts expanded
A changed file under the answer opens Last turn in Changes with that file expanded
